item.title: Metairie parades, routes and times for Mardi Gras 2026
item.description: Mardi Gras season is here, and many revelers are ready to enjoy all the festivities in store. If you don't want to venture out into the Crescent City to join the party, you can catch parades in Metairie.

item.title: Portion of River Road reopens after vehicle crash in Garyville
item.description: A portion of River Road from Louisiana 54 to Daffodil Street is closed in both directions due to a vehicle crash that happened on Friday, Jan. 30.

item.title: Shooting at Mardi Gras parade in Clinton leaves five injured
